name: Mikoshiba Iori
source: [url=/c47159]Rikurou's[/url] childhood friend and classmate. She is popular due to her beautiful and dignified appearance, and everyone (mostly the boys) has a hard time looking the other way when she's wearing a swimsuit. Iori is quite stubborn and also in love with Rikurou, though she doesn't want to admit this to herself.
